title: Stop guessing which AI is best: Get GPT, Claude, and Gemini for under $100
content_html:
TL;DR: A lifetime subscription to the 1min.AI Advanced Business Plan is $99.99 (reg. $540). That’s 81% off, and it includes 4 million credits per month for a long list of AI models.

Credit: 1minAI

$99.99
$540 Save $440.01

One AI writes cleaner copy. Another handles code better. A third is stronger in research. Keeping up with which one does what, and paying for each, gets old quickly.

1min.AI puts them in one app, so you can stop guessing. For a limited time, the Advanced Business Plan is $99.99 for life.

You can chat with models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta, Mistral, and Cohere, including GPT-5.5 Pro, Claude 4.6 Sonnet, and Gemini 3.1 Pro. Try the same prompt across a few of them and keep the answer you like. For more on how these models compare, check out Mashable’s [AI coverage](INTERNAL LINK: Mashable AI category page).

1min.AI also includes task-specific tools like a summarizer, paraphraser, and grammar checker. It also has image tools for generation, upscaling, and background removal.

There are PDF and document tools, plus audio and video features such as text-to-speech, transcription, and text-to-video. The plan supports up to 20 team members and works on the web, Windows, Mac, iPhone, iPad, and Android.

Here’s the catch. Everything runs on credits. The plan includes 4 million per month, plus up to 450,000 more if you log in daily. That works out to roughly 1.1 million words or about 1,186 images per month. Heavier tasks like video use credits much faster, and flagship models may burn through them quicker. You’ll also need to redeem your code within 30 days of purchase.

Mashable Deals

By signing up, you agree to receive recurring automated SMS marketing messages from Mashable Deals at the number provided. Msg and data rates may apply. Up to 2 messages/day. Reply STOP to opt out, HELP for help. Consent is not a condition of purchase. See our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.

If you use AI often and want to stop switching between apps, this is worth a look. Get a lifetime subscription to the 1min.AI Advanced Business Plan for $99.99 (reg. $540).

StackSocial prices subject to change.
